spans.s:
n. (-लं)
Cow's urine.
E.
गो, and जल water.

m. (-कः)
A prickly nightshade.
n. (-कं)
Happy, fortunate, auspicious.
E.
गो the earth, जागृ to wake or to be awake, affix ठक्.

f. (-ह्वा)
A potherb growing wild, (Elephantophus scaber.)
E.
गो a cow, and जिह्वा a tongue: the leaves being so compared; also with कन् added गोजिह्वका.
